text.p: Typhoon Violet intensifying in the waters south of Japan... Typhoon Violet, with 130 mph winds, is over open waters near 19n/127e, and moving to the north northwest at about 7 mph. Violet is expected to continue to intensify with top winds reaching supertyphoon strength, or around 155 mph, during the next 36 to 48 hours. By 48 to 60 hours, late Tuesday or early Wednesday local time, the storm may near Okinawa, Japan, as a major typhoon. Shipping will also be threatened in the waters south of Japan this period.

Typhoon Tom is moving away from the Mariana Islands... Typhoon Tom, with 75 mph winds, is in the western Pacific near 21n/146e, moving east northeast at 9 mph. Tom will continue to track away from the northern Mariana Islands with top winds between 75 and 80 mph during the next 36 to 48 hours. Tom will be a threat to shipping.

Tropical Storm Hortense, 250 miles west southwest of Saint Johns Newfoundland, is moving quickly to the east northeast near 21 mph, and will move across southern Newfoundland today and this evening. Top winds are near 60 mph and some weakening will continue as the storm loses its tropical characteristics by tonight. A high wind and heavy rain advisory is up for southern Newfoundland and the adjacent coastal waters.
